ammonia.reason: Very short aging limits amino acid deamination and urease ammonia release.

animal_barnyard.reason: Pasteurized cow milk and no washed rind limits p-cresol, indole and skatole.

bitter.reason: Short ripening limits accumulation of hydrophobic bitter peptides from chymosin.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation so no 2-heptanone/2-nonanone methyl ketones.

browning.reason: High moisture young curd with residual lactose and lysine gives moderate Maillard browning.

buttery.reason: Citrate fermentation by Lactococcus lactis biovar diacetylactis yields diacetyl and acetoin.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Mild lipolysis yields 226 mg/100g DM butyric acid plus some C6-C8 free fatty acids.

creaminess.reason: High moisture 46% and ~61% fat-in-dry-matter with uncooked rennet curd gives creamy mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: Young elastic rennet gel at pH 5.4 retains calcium phosphate crosslinks, not crumbly.

firmness.reason: Semi-soft uncooked pressed paste with 46% moisture and 6-30 days aging stays soft.

floral_honey.reason: Low phenylalanine catabolism limits phenylacetaldehyde and 2-phenylethanol.

fruity.reason: Only ethyl acetate detected in pasteurized type, little esterase ethyl butanoate/hexanoate.

goaty.reason: Cow milk fat lacks high 4-methyloctanoic and 4-ethyloctanoic goaty acids.

malty_nutty.reason: Short age and low branched-chain Strecker aldehydes 3-methylbutanal/2-methylpropanal.

melt.reason: pH 5.4 demineralized young casein with intact network flows well on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: No Geotrichum/Penicillium camemberti so no 1-octen-3-ol or 1-octen-3-one.

oil_off.reason: Young high-moisture emulsion with intact fat globules releases little free oil.

smoky.reason: No smoking step so no guaiacol or syringol phenols.

sour_vinegar.reason: High lactic 14601 mg/100g DM plus acetic 1006 mg/100g DM from heterofermentation.

stretch.reason: Rennet curd not pasta-filata heated-kneaded, so no aligned paracasein fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: No high cook, low methionine catabolism limits methanethiol and methional.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose/galactose and diacetyl/acetoin impart mild sweet milky note.

umami.reason: Limited proteolysis in 6-day cheese yields low free glutamate from casein.
